note: Ground truth is written before the case is executed. See GROUND_TRUTH.md for how each expected value was decided.

cases.why: A normal patch and minor upgrade of a well behaved library. Nothing in the demo project touches a removed API, so both environments build and all tests pass.
Jinja2 3.1 removed the jinja2.Markup alias. notesapp/render.py imports it, so the render tests stop working only in the upgraded environment.
There is no requests 2.99.0 on PyPI, so the upgraded environment cannot be built at all. This checks that a failed build is reported as a build failure and not as a test problem.
certifi is published under MPL-2.0 and the strict policy does not allow MPL-2.0. Under strict licence mode the resulting environment cannot be distributed under that policy.
requests 2.26 replaced chardet, which is LGPL, with charset-normalizer, which is MIT. The upgrade should pass and the evidence should show the LGPL package leaving the dependency graph.
